decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch close to the established range and already publicly presented on its own page, management would be inclined to continue backing it because the investment is recent, visible and easy to justify in a growing market.

This articulated construction dumper extends the core construction equipment business, so under escalation of commitment management would keep it on the market to defend the resources and public commitment already made.

Although more distant from the established offer, the underground mine rescue vehicle fits the firm's problem-solving identity in demanding underground applications, and with only one year on the market management would likely attribute any weak traction to a temporary market-development phase rather than exit now.

Because the compact telescopic loader builds on existing capabilities, has already been visibly launched and sits within the firm's stated innovative refinement path, management would likely persist with it rather than withdraw after such a short time.
